tables.name: personal_browser_jobs
tables.owner_query: SELECT b.rowid AS rid,r.account_id,b.tenant_id FROM personal_browser_jobs b JOIN chat_runs r ON r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND r.id=b.run_id AND r.thread_id=b.thread_id
tables.key_transition: Fence browser work and revoke live control on restore. Never reissue controller handles or replay an uncertain input.
tables.verification: Reconcile every row to its conversation and exact owning chat run. A retained view is not a live Chromium session.
tables.on_failure: Stop extraction and quarantine ambiguous browser ownership.
